name: rxjs-pure-fp
description: A pure functional reimplementation experiment targeting RxJS 7.8.2 behavior without class or inheritance architecture.

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.esm.json && tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && tsc -p tsconfig.types.json && node tools/prepare-dist.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run architecture:check && npm run test && npm run test:differential && npm run build && npm run parity:exports && npm run dist:check
